label: RosmerTA system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component RosmerTA locus represented by RmrA and RmrT profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: RosmerTA branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual rmrA or rmrT genes, RmrA or RmrT proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one RosmerTA locus, unresolved RosmerTA trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
